title: Raw String for Emails or Phone Numbers
pattern: Using unstructured primitive `String` types to represent formatted, verified domain constructs like emails or phone numbers.
why_bad: It forces heap allocations and provides no guarantee that the contained text is valid. Every downstream consumer must perform defensive formatting and validation, duplicating sanitization logic across the codebase.
detection: Struct fields representing emails, phone numbers, or zip codes typed as `String` without wrapper verification.
counterexample: A free-text comment box or address field where any arbitrary Unicode input is valid.
source: *Refactoring* by Martin Fowler (p. 84, 144); *Domain Modeling made Functional* (p. 75).
